from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CostLineItem(BaseModel):
    """A reported cost line item from a single financial filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company in this document")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label text of the expense line item found (e.g. 'Total operating expenses')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The reported amount value")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by this figure")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount (e.g., 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars')")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim text excerpt containing the label and amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Parsed data for all financial documents provided."""
    cost_line_items: list[CostLineItem]
